title: Robotic Claw Machine
what: A functional claw machine built using LEGO robotics with operational claw, joystick, and grab mechanism. Features accurate grab-and-drop and smooth joystick control of the claw along LEGO axis.
why: Created as a team project for a first-year Mechatronics robotics course to apply mechanical, programming, and design concepts learned throughout first year courses while earning course credit.
how: Constructed using LEGO motors, designed claw parts in CAD for planning, constructed final parts in LEGO, mounted robotic parts to a frame, and programmed joystick for servo movement using RobotC (C++).
